items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: Charlie and I, we grew up together. We came up together. ... I remember one time we were in Oakland, California, and we were with Floyd Ray’s band.

ctx.x: Chico Hamilton was born in Los Angeles on September 21, 1921 and has enjoyed a versatile career as a drummer, band leader and producer. He grew up in the fertile music scene of Central Avenue and his band mates included Buddy Collette, Charles Mingus, Dexter Gordon and other future jazz greats.

The 1955 Chico Hamilton Quintet created a distinctive sound with its combination of guitar, cello and woodwinds, and helped introduce Eric Dolphy to the jazz world. Chico moved to New York in 1966 and founded a production company that created music for numerous television shows, movies and advertisements. He continues to the present day to be an innovative band leader, percussionist, recording artist and talent scout.

items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mingus was on that band. And I learned how to play for strippers... Buddy, myself, Jack, Eddie Taylor, Mingus was on that band.

ctx.x: Stay in school. He told me to stay in school, you know, and that was cool. So in the meantime, Lee was playing with Lorenzo Flennoy and they were playing at the Club Alabam, which was the number one club there, which was equivalent to the Cotton Club here in New York. They had a line of girls, chorus line, singers, dancers, and entertainers, you know, comedians, and I started subbing for Lee playing the show. In the meantime our band that we used to have, we took a gig at the Follies and Buddy, myself, Jack,…
Sing that pattern, the kick pattern for the strippers.

items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mingus, I met Mingus man, through Buddy.

ctx.x: And Jack Kelso. And they all said that you played in bands so let’s go over each one of those folks. We already talked about your meeting Jack Kelso. We just talked about your meeting Dex. How about meeting Mingus?
Mingus, I met Mingus man, through Buddy.
So let’s talk about Buddy. Buddy seems to be a real key figure.
